speaker: SPEAKER_00
transcript: It's an exciting time. I mean, I think the country is saying something right now. They're saying, wait, if you talk to the American public, and I meet with people constantly, up here in Florida, they want a government that deals with inflation. They want a government that gets interest rates down. They want a government to make sure they've come up with their retirement. They want a government to get medical costs down. That's what they want out of their government. They don't want to be at war all the time. They want a government that's accountable. And I think what we're doing, and I think what's happening in these elections and what's happening after they get elected, they're saying, okay, How do we provide the public with what I told them I was going to do? And that's the fight we're having right now. It is hard. It's hard to balance the budget. I did it as governor. I thought I had to balance the budget in 20 years before I became governor. I did it. It's hard, right? We have to do that. If we want to get inflation to the control and we get interest rates down, you'd have to balance the budget. Well, that means you have to make choices. And what I've watched up here is people don't want to make a choice. They say, well, we're just going to take care of everybody. We're going to throw all the money out there. And that's why we're in position. We're in. This is a game changer. Take Schooner and McConnell. While they've been up here in leadership, the debt has gone from $5 to $3 trillion. The public is mad about that. And so it's filtered into how do we change things up here? We see is broken. And so I think the Republican Party, as long as we stand and fight for what we believe in, we're going to have a bright future. Now, if we become Democrat-like and don't say, well, I told you I want to bounce a budget, but I'm not really going to try, why would you elect somebody like that? So that's why I fight for, I fight for what I told people, I fight for a balanced budget. Is it hard? Yeah, but I'm going to fight for it every day and we're going to get there. I'm committed to get fiscal sanity to the federal government. That's what I ran on because I know that's better for every family in Florida.
